room_rent.note: Policy wording does not mention any room rent cap or category restriction; however sub-limits on procedures and co-payments apply

icu.note: No explicit ICU cap mentioned in policy wording

copayment.display: 50% on PED claims; 25% on all other claims (waivable)
copayment.note: 50% co-pay on PED hospitalisation claims is mandatory lifelong and cannot be waived. 25% co-pay on all other claims is waivable by paying 20% additional loading on standard premium. Co-pays do not apply to pre/post-hospitalisation expenses or listed sub-limit procedures.

sub_limits.display: CABG, PTCA, Cataract, Knee/Hip Replacement capped; Modern treatments 50% of SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract per eye: ₹15k–₹25k; CABG/PTCA/Total Knee/Hip Replacement: ₹1.5L–₹3.5L depending on SI. Modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, etc.) capped at 50% of SI per policy period.

ped_waiting.note: 12 months continuous coverage required; reducible via portability credit

specific_disease_waiting.note: Applies to cataract, glaucoma, hernia, thyroid, varicose veins, prostate, kidney stones, joint/bone diseases, tumours/cysts and many others as listed

maternity.note: Maternity is explicitly excluded (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: Policy wording does not mention any cumulative/no-claim bonus benefit

restoration.note: No restoration or reinstatement of sum insured mentioned in policy wording

pre_hosp.note: Combined pre & post-hospitalisation expenses capped at 2% of SI, max ₹10,000 per hospitalisation

post_hosp.note: Combined pre & post-hospitalisation expenses capped at 2% of SI, max ₹10,000 per hospitalisation

day_care.note: Extensive list of 400+ procedures covered; also any other procedure agreed by insurer requiring <24 hrs hospitalisation

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation is explicitly excluded under specific exclusions (Section C.3.y)

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation for accident and illness covered; preventive and rejuvenation treatments excluded

organ_donor.note: Donor screening, treatment and surgery expenses explicitly excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance charges reimbursed up to ₹1,000 per hospitalisation on production of original bills

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, deep brain stimulation, etc.) covered but capped at 50% of SI per policy period; further restricted to applicable sub-limit if procedure also has a sub-limit

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical consumables (gloves, masks, etc.) explicitly excluded in Annexure 2

global_cover.note: Coverage restricted to India only; treatment outside India explicitly excluded

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, no claim contestable except on grounds of established fraud

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for annual/quarterly/half-yearly; 15 days for monthly instalment mode

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or portability/migration

portability.note: As per IRDAI portability guidelines; apply at least 45 days before renewal

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary hospitalisation, treatment outside India, organ donor expenses, maternity, OPD, stem cell storage, durable medical equipment, dental (non-accidental)

optional_riders.display: 25% co-pay waiver (20% premium loading); long-term policy discount (5%/10% for 2/3 yr); family discount 10%
